reason: A linked worktree reused shared core.hooksPath while its generated hook environment was checkout-local, causing a valid commit to invoke the fallback vendor/bin/agent-loop path and fail. The hook environment now pins the repository-local CLI path and resolves the current Git root, making this a repeatable worktree-safe precedent.
new: Git hook configuration may be shared across linked worktrees while generated hook environment is checkout-local; resolve the current Git root first and pin the executable CLI path in the generated environment instead of relying on a relative fallback.
boundary: Applies to package-owned Git hooks used from linked worktrees. It does not change Git's shared configuration semantics or make hooks a correctness/security boundary.
scope_justification: A linked worktree reused shared core.hooksPath while its generated hook environment was checkout-local, causing a valid commit to invoke the fallback vendor/bin/agent-loop path and fail. The hook environment now pins the repository-local CLI path and resolves the current Git root, making this a repeatable worktree-safe precedent.

validation_case.given: a linked worktree sharing core.hooksPath with its main checkout while generated hook environment is ignored per checkout
validation_case.when: the hook resolves its tool through a relative vendor/bin fallback or changes directory to the hook file's common checkout
validation_case.then: the hook can run the wrong root or fail to find the executable, so it resolves the current Git root and uses a pinned repository-local CLI path
